apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.3.2 — Varisai loop seam fix: the seam timer did not count the pass lead-in, so from the second pass onward the audio started about 80 ms ahead of the pass boundary (and of the highlight grid). The seam now lands exactly on the boundary, like the web. Includes v1.3.1 (background keep-alive for phrase loops) and v1.3.0 (Varisai Practice Dock).
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Varisai seam timing fix; background phrase loops; Practice Dock.
